ABSENCE PROOF (per brief section 4, not relying on search alone): fetched and grepped the full product+category sitemap (media/sitemap_en_ca.xml, ~3550 URLs) for dog/cat/leash/collar/kennel/crate/litter/scratch/pet-bed/pet-bowl/pet-feed substrings.
